_note: SYNTHETIC fast-fail case, not an observed run. Represents the narrow case the retry watchdog exists for: the platform never provisioned a sandbox and the run died early (~120 s, far below the ~1920 s ceiling), with no sandbox_id and no conversation. Every run we have actually observed carrying the 'environment_unavailable' string was in fact a budget overrun (see run-budget-overrun.json), which a retry cannot fix.
